testPolicy.text: Georgetown requires submission of either SAT or ACT scores as part of the application process, and requires official scores. AP scores are highly recommended for students who took AP exams. CDS 2025-26 C8 marks SAT or ACT as required for students applying for Fall 2027.

Nursing students: tuition and fees 75,091, total 101,423.

aidPromise.text: Financial aid at Georgetown is based on need; there are no academic or merit-based scholarships. Georgetown meets the full need of eligible students (US citizens and permanent residents) through a combination of grants, scholarships, employment, and federal student loans. Aid for non-US citizens/permanent residents is limited to a small number of need-based awards.

deadlines.early: November 1 (Early Action, non-binding, decisions by December 15)

facts.text: Georgetown has no binding Early Decision; its non-binding Early Action (November 1) bars applicants from binding ED elsewhere but allows other non-binding Early Action plans.

Applicants apply to one undergraduate school (College of Arts and Sciences, Walsh School of Foreign Service, McDonough School of Business, Berkley School of Nursing, School of Health, McCourt School of Public Policy), each with its own essay.
An alumni interview is part of the first-year application and applicants are required to complete it when assigned.
Aid is need-based only (no merit scholarships), and Georgetown's packages to meet full need can include federal student loans.
For fall 2025, international applicants were 3,926 of 26,822 applicants but only 326 of 3,618 admits; 356 students were admitted from the waiting list.
The 2026-27 first-year cost of attendance is $100,864 ($101,423 in nursing).
